result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The convention-related tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I added no new tests and did not check the new patterns against sample files.

- **Generated HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well.
- **JS `// Generated by …` rule:** the path pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*/.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML rule:** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*/.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **Gradle JS rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment.

The old matches still hold. The content patterns are unchanged, so a hand-written `.htm`, `.js` or `.xml` file stays in the main scope.

The neighbouring rule `.*/[.](css|js)[.]map` (JS/CSS map files) has the same typo and only matches a file literally named `.js.map`. It wasn't in your list, so I left it alone.
